title: Git-backed sync workflow for data folder
description: Document and implement the git-friendly sync flow for the data folder (commit, pull/rebase, push) and CLI affordances if needed.

title: Define local data schema + markdown/json layout
description: Define strict JSON on-disk schema for todos/notes (canonical) with a per-customer file layout; allow migration from single customer file to folder if size grows; Markdown is optional/freeform for docs/notes and email summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Schema doc defines canonical JSON format and per-customer file layout; specifies customer file->folder migration strategy; Markdown usage is explicitly non-canonical and optional for notes/docs/email summaries; example data files included; diff-friendly conventions documented (stable ordering, IDs, timestamps).

title: Build CLI workflows for notes/todos + agent run
description: Design CLI workflows for quick call note capture, call planning from recent notes per customer, and agent runs via stdin/stdout or file inputs.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports fast note capture for active/upcoming calls; can generate a formatted Markdown call doc + editable email summary; can plan a call by summarizing/reviewing recent notes for a specific customer; agent run flow supports JSON/file inputs.

title: Spec agent/plugin contract + manifest schema
description: Define agent manifest format, capabilities, input/output schema, and allowlisted read/write scopes for CLI execution; include a first-class call-planning agent contract.

title: Customer bootstrap + detail management
description: Add a CLI flow to create customer files quickly and update UI to show per-customer todos/agenda with basic management.

title: Agent ingestion pipeline for call notes
description: Implement agent ingestion for call notes that can format raw notes into structured JSON + Markdown summaries and assist with call planning per customer; support UI-triggered 'make agenda' requests.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can ingest raw call notes and emit structured JSON plus a Markdown summary/email draft; supports planning prompts like 'review last few calls with X and plan my call'; writes todos through storage adapter.

title: Add testing strategy + harness from the start
description: Establish test tooling and baseline tests for storage adapter, CLI workflows, agent IO, and UI interactions as features land.
acceptance_criteria: Testing approach documented; harness set up for backend/CLI modules and UI; first tests added alongside initial schema/storage/CLI work.

title: UI list + grouped kanban in Chakra
description: Implement the basic list view and grouped kanban view (by status/account) in the Vite + Chakra UI client; include per-customer call pages with a 'Make agenda' action and Markdown doc viewer.
acceptance_criteria: UI provides list + grouped kanban; per-customer view includes a 'Make agenda' action that triggers agent/CLI flow; Markdown call doc is viewable in-app with basic formatting.

title: Wire UI to local data + agent runtime
description: Connect the web UI to the local data store/CLI so 'Make agenda' triggers the agent and renders real markdown from customer files.

title: Enforce agent allowlist + sandboxing
description: Implement runtime checks for agent read/write scopes and disable network by default.

title: Implement file-first storage adapter boundary
description: Create storage adapter interfaces and a file-backed implementation for strict JSON todos/notes, with Markdown only for freeform docs/notes as separate artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Storage adapter interface defined; file-backed adapter reads/writes strict JSON for todos/notes; Markdown handled only as freeform adjuncts; round-trip tests or sample fixtures demonstrate correctness; error handling for invalid schema documented.
